messages:
alex: Quick flag 1: retention language in /audit/privileged-logs is ambiguous (says "90 days default" and also "customer-managed TTL"). plus the Ruby example references an old SDK call.

maria: Can you paste the snippet lines? I can open a docs PR.

alex: Retention paragraph: "We retain privileged audit logs for 90 days by default; customers can configure TTL via the API." Then the Ruby snippet uses `client.audit.export` which is deprecated.

kevin: For SOC2 phrasing I'd suggest: "Tenant-configurable retention period (default: 90 days). Exports available for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval." terse and precise.

jamal: @docs-bot running a quick link-check on /audit/** now.
docs-bot: scheduled link-check for /audit/** 1 results expected in a few minutes.

alex: Also want a minimal JSONL example that shows pseudonymized user IDs and the privileged_event type for clarity.

maria: copying a compact JSONL example to include:

maria: ```json
{"event_type":"privileged_event","user_id":"pseudonym:U_3f2a","action":"vault_key_grant","timestamp":"2025-08-12T09:15:00Z","details":{"target":"db-prod-1"}}
```

kevin: That works. Add a parenthetical that Redwood admins do not have plaintext tenant data access except under documented emergency procedures.

alex: Also update curl examples to `--header 'Accept: application/jsonl'` and point to `/v1/audit/export`.

maria: I'll open PR titled "clarify privileged audit retention + update SDK examples + add JSONL sample" and drop the PR link here.

jamal: docs-bot: link-check complete 1 found 2 broken links: /sdk/ruby/audit_export (404) and /examples/jsonl-schema (404).

maria: thanks 1 I'll add redirects for the old SDK paths and fix the example path.

alex: wording nit: replace "we may access" with "Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval" to avoid ambiguity.

kevin: LGTM. Add a short changelog entry for the docs release notes and tag it docs-only.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4199 1 preview deployed.

docs-bot: deploy-preview available 1 https://deploy-preview-4199--docs.redwood.ai

jamal: looping legal for a quick look, added @sophia-legal to reviewers.
sophia-legal: skimmed 1 wording looks fine. Two small edits: prefer "tenant-configurable retention period" and add a link to internal emergency-access playbook. Approve after those changes.

maria: updated per legal and added redirect rules for the Ruby SDK paths. Final copy now: "Tenant-configurable retention period (default 90 days). Exports supported for audits. Redwood staff access requires documented emergency approval."

alex: perfect, thanks all.

maria: merging after CI succeeds. I'll also ping SDK owners about the method rename so they can cut a patch release.

kevin: thanks. I'll add a note to the release checklist to ensure redirects are monitored post-merge.

jamal: I'll confirm the redirect rules after merge and mark the support tickets resolved.

maria: merged 1 closing the loop.
